description.value: Dialog overlay. Open it with a button carrying data-ai-toggle="modal" data-ai-target="#id", or with window.LLMCSS.open(). Add the open attribute for the initial state.
Open state. Interchangeable with the is-open class; the runtime sets both.
Tab set. Each button.ai-tab inside carries data-ai-tab="#panel-id"; the runtime syncs aria-selected and tabindex.
